title: Sector-dominant graph-local drivers for path-window barrier Hamiltonians on the Boolean hypercube
summary: We study finite-size adiabatic state preparation on Boolean hypercubes using graph-local drivers built from sector/path coordinates related to monotone Gray-code representatives. The construction is not presented as a new all-$n$ Gray-code existence theorem; rather, it provides finite representatives, explicitly checked through the cases used in the numerical experiments, for testing problem-dependent graph-local drivers.
